INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — MORNING. morning. Natural lighting appropriate to morning. #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. detailed_description:
The video is filmed in a modern social-first product photography style with tactile, editorial energy. The lighting is bright, natural morning light with crisp whites and a palette of #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, and #E8F4E8, creating an airy atmosphere with lifted shadows.
[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the scene begins exactly as <Image 1>. <Subject 1> stands in a sleek downtown apartment bathroom. <Subject 1> holds <Subject 2> in her right hand, looking into the large rectangular mirror. With a smooth tactile motion, she twists the base of <Subject 2> upward, revealing the coral bullet. <Subject 1> then carefully applies the lipstick to her lower lip. The reflection in the mirror is clear and legible, showing the precise application of the coral pigment. The camera performs a smooth, energetic handheld drift, subtly moving in toward her face to capture the texture of the lipstick and the warmth of her skin. The background features white subway tiles and a window with a soft-focus city view. 

overall_soundscape:
The soft, mechanical click and friction of the lipstick tube twisting upward, followed by the faint, creamy sound of the product gliding against skin. Ambient quiet silence of a morning in an apartment is present.
